operations.title: The canonical Entry 1054 reply carries one erroneous supersedes edge
operations.body: In event 707, the canonical reply was accidentally linked as superseding maricicommunication:0a7c0b2be503997c7cbe. That target is unrelated. The intended predecessor is maricicommunication:076cbe3df09786ded700 from event 704. The erroneous immutable edge must be disregarded; the separately admitted correct edge is authoritative for this correction chain.
